name: Carmel (of Judah)

identification.note: Distinct from Mount Carmel, the mountain in the north associated with Elijah — this Carmel is a town in Judah's hill country.

description: A town in Judah's hill country where the wealthy but foolish Nabal kept his flocks; his wife Abigail's wise intervention there kept David from bloodshed after Nabal insulted him (1 Samuel 25).
